utterances.speaker: JUDGE VAZ
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The hearing is opened. Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen. I am now going to give the floor to Madame Registrar. Could you please call the case, Madame Registrar. You have the floor, Madame.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. Good afternoon to everyone in the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-83-A, the Prosecutor versus Rasim Delic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VAZ
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much, Madame Registrar. I am now turning to Mr. Delic. Mr. Delic, can you hear me and can you follow the proceedings in a language that you understand?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I can. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VAZ
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much, Mr. Delic. I would now like to ask the parties to give me their appearances, and I would like to start with the Prosecutor, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. MARTIN SALGADO
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Elena Martin Salgado. I'm appearing on behalf of the Prosecution with appeals counsel Michelle Jarvis and case manager Alma Imamovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VAZ
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much, Madame. And for the Defence, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. VIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honours. Good afternoon to everyone in this courtroom, to my colleagues from the OTP. My name is Vasvija Vidovic, and I represent General Rasim Delic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VAZ
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much, Madame. In this case, both parties filed their notices of appeal on the judgement rendered by the Trial Chamber on 15 September 2008. While awaiting the appeals decision, Mr. Delic is in custody at the UNDU in The Hague in the Netherlands. Under the provisions of Rule 65 bis(B) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence of the Tribunal, an Appeals Chamber or an Appeals Judge shall convene a Status Conference within 120 days of the filing of a notice of appeal to allow any person in custody, pending appeal, the opportunity to raise issues in relation thereto. The order for this Status Conference was issued on 11 December 2008. This is, therefore, our first meeting pursuant to Rule 65 bis, and I would like to ask Mr. Delic - Mr. Delic, I'm turning to you - would you like to raise any particular issues that you have in relation to your detention conditions or in relation to your mental and physical condition? You have the floor.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Madame Judge, I have no problems. Both psychologically and physically, I am all right. My health condition is under control, and I don't have any issues to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VAZ
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. Thank you very much, Mr. Delic. You may sit down. I see that your counsel is showing that she agrees with her client, so thank you very much, Madame. As regards the status of the case in appeal, I would like to remind the parties of the order of 2008 in relation to the composition of the Judges of the Appeals Chamber, Judges appointed to the case. I would like to remind all parties that this decision was -- or that order was taken on that date. I also know that as regards the notice of appeal filed by the Prosecution, all briefs were filed within the time-limits with respect to the appeal of Rasim Delic. We were seized with his notice of appeal on 14th of October, 2008, his appellant's brief, under seal, on the 26th of December, 2008, followed by a public unsealed redacted version filed on the 7th of January, 2009. We have taken note of this, of his brief of the 26th of December, 2008. To this effect, after consulting with my colleagues, I can confirm that the amendments in question, since they are talking about the form, were accepted without an authorisation by the Appeals Chamber under Rule 108 of the Rules. No comments to make as regards the OTP?

utterances.speaker: MS. MARTIN SALGADO
utterances.text: Your Honour, I would just like to confirm that the filed version of the Defence appeal brief was filed by the Registry on the 29th of December, 2008. I just wanted to make that clarification. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VAZ
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. We take note of this different date. So it's the 29th of December, 2008. Thank you very much. We note that the respondent's brief by the Prosecution shall be filed by 9 February 2009, at the latest, meaning that the delay for the filing of the brief in reply will expire on the 24th of February, 2009. Very well. I believe that parties have no additional comments to make. Therefore, under reserve of the filing of the above-mentioned briefs and eventual amendments under Rules 108 and 115 of the Rules, the briefs filed by the parties shall be analysed by the Appeals Chamber as they currently are, in their current form. Do the parties have any specific comments to make as to the status of the appeals case or as to the briefs, other than what you've mentioned to us earlier with respect to the modification of the date? Do you have any other comments to make?

utterances.speaker: MS. MARTIN SALGADO
utterances.text: We don't have any issues to raise at this point. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MS. VIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, the Defence also has no other questions, other than the ones already raised in our briefs, but nothing more at this point in time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VAZ
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. Thank you very much. As far as I'm concerned, I don't have any other questions to raise, and obviously since I've asked you to make your comments on what I've said, you may ask any questions if you wish to do so at this stage. If there are no questions on behalf of the Prosecution or the Defence? No. Well, in that case, I would like to say the following before this Status Conference is adjourned. I would like to thank the parties. I would like to thank the legal interpreters, the interpreters -- the legal assistants, the interpreters, and all the other people involved in this Status Conference. The Status Conference is adjourned. Thank you very much. Have a nice afternoon.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at
